name: American History
description: History centered on the United States, its peoples, institutions, and global role.

name: World History
description: History centered outside the United States or across multiple regions, empires, or global systems.

name: History
description: Historical works not better classified under American History, World History, or War & Military.

name: Biography
description: Life stories written about another person or group of people.

name: Memoir & Autobiography
description: First-person life writing, personal history, and autobiographical nonfiction.

name: Politics & Government
description: Politics, elections, public policy, statecraft, diplomacy, and government institutions.

name: Society & Culture
description: Social life, cultural change, communities, institutions, and contemporary public debates.

name: Journalism & Reportage
description: Reported nonfiction, investigative work, contemporary events, and narrative journalism.

name: Science
description: Natural sciences, mathematics, psychology, and scientific discovery.

name: Medicine & Public Health
description: Medicine, disease, health systems, public health, and the body.

name: Nature & Environment
description: Natural history, animals, ecology, climate, conservation, and environmental change.

name: Technology
description: Technology, computing, engineering, infrastructure, and their social effects.

name: Business & Economics
description: Business, labor, finance, markets, economic history, and capitalism.

name: Arts & Criticism
description: Art, music, film, performance, literary criticism, and cultural criticism.

name: Religion
description: Religion, spirituality, theology, religious history, and belief.

name: War & Military
description: War, military institutions, battles, soldiers, and armed conflict.

name: Race & Ethnicity
description: Race, ethnicity, civil rights, migration, indigeneity, diaspora, and racial inequality.

name: Gender & Sexuality
description: Gender, sexuality, feminism, LGBTQ life, reproductive politics, and gendered experience.

name: Travel & Place
description: Travel writing, place-based narrative, geography, landscapes, and local exploration.

name: Sports
description: Sports, athletes, sporting cultures, and athletic institutions.

name: True Crime & Justice
description: Crime, courts, policing, prisons, legal systems, and miscarriages of justice.

name: General Nonfiction
description: Nonfiction works that do not yet have enough signal for a more specific subject.
